name: app-oviah-log-track-user-flow-diamond-decision
title: OVIAH 'Track: Log Period / Symptom / Mood' user flow with a diamond decision node branching to five log types
whatItIs: A flowchart from Home through 'Log / Add' into a red diamond decision ('What do you want to log/track?') branching to five options (Period, Symptoms, Mood, Lifestyle, Medication), converging on 'Enter Detail', then splitting to 'Data Saved Successfully' or 'Save as draft', looping back to an updated Home via a dashed arrow.
whatItMeans: Clear and looping; the diamond decision node makes a five-way branch easy to follow at a glance.
techniques: Use a diamond shape specifically for decision points.
Converge multiple branches back into one shared step.
Loop the flow back to an 'updated' version of the start state.

vocabulary.definition: A diamond-shaped flowchart step representing a choice.
A path that returns to an earlier state, often updated.
